## What changed?

Describe the example, correction, or layout improvement.

## Source and verification

For new content, link the original source and state whether you reproduced it.

## Before submitting

- [ ] Updated the source data, not only generated README files.
- [ ] Recorded creator credit, known model settings, and content terms.
- [ ] Included the required preview/reference files or original-source links.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/build_readme.py`.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/validate.py` and `python3 scripts/build_readme.py --check`.

For changes without new content, mark only the relevant items and explain the rest.
